trash.title: Trash
trash.description: {count, plural, =1 {One page in the trash} one {# page in the trash} other {# pages in the trash}}. Indented means: was nested underneath. Clicking the title shows the page read-only.
trash.emptyDescription: What you move to the trash stays here until someone restores it or deletes it permanently.
trash.selectedCount: {count, plural, one {# page selected} other {# pages selected}}
trash.confirmChecking: Checking what will be removed with it…
trash.deletionPages: {count, plural, =1 {One page will be} one {# page will be} other {# pages will be}} deleted with all content, all versions, and all comments.
trash.deletionAttachments: Plus {count, plural, =1 {one attachment} one {# attachment} other {# attachments}} including files.
trash.deletionLinks: {count, plural, =1 {A link from another page points to it and will then be shown as unresolved.} one {# link from another page points to it and will then be shown as unresolved.} other {# links from other pages point to it and will then be shown as unresolved.}}
trash.deletionIrreversible: This cannot be undone, not even via version history.

capture.title: Capture
capture.description: Lands in the inbox. The first line becomes the title; sort it later.
capture.textPlaceholder: What do you want to remember?

moveWorkspace.title: Move to another workspace
moveWorkspace.description: “{title}” will move with all subpages, attachments, and embedded databases to the selected workspace. Content that only you could see before will then be visible to its members just like any other page there.

suggestParent.title: Suggest matching location
suggestParent.description: Looking for pages closest in content to “{title}”. Suggesting where most of them already belong.
suggestParent.shareWarning: “{target}” is shared externally, along with everything under it. If “{title}” ends up there, it will also be shared:
suggestParent.sharePublicLink: Public link (anyone with the address can read)
suggestParent.emptyDescription: There are no pages close enough in content to this one. Move it manually in the page tree.

templatePicker.title: New page from template
templatePicker.description: The content of the template is copied. The new page is then a regular page with no link to the template.
templatePicker.titlePlaceholder: Otherwise determined by the template’s title pattern
templatePicker.emptyDescription: Open a recurring page and mark it as a template in the page menu.

markdownImport.title: Import Markdown
markdownImport.description: The content will be created as a new page. Frontmatter, task lists, tables, wiki links, and callouts will be included.

clip.intro: Lands in the workspace’s inbox. File it later.
clip.fetchPageHint: The page will be loaded in the browser for this, which takes a moment.
clip.notePlaceholder: What do you want to remember?
clip.bookmarkletIntro: Drag the button to your bookmarks bar. Clicking it sends the open page and any selected text here. On your phone, you don’t need it: install eXocortex, and it will appear in the share menu.

activity.noPageDescription: Open a page to see its activity.
activity.historyLoadError: The history could not be loaded.
activity.pageLoadError: The page could not be loaded.
activity.emptyDescription: As soon as something changes on this page, it will appear here.
activity.restoreDescription: The page content will be restored to the snapshot from {date}. The current snapshot will be saved automatically beforehand, but the restore itself cannot be undone. An open page will apply the change immediately.
